name: foundry
description: Idea to merge with YouTrack, Linear, or qualified private personal GitHub Projects and the GitHub code-host. Bounded writes, versioned ADRs, and proof-bound delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Frame, plan, execute, and merge with durable project memory.
interface.longDescription: Frame ADR-backed issues and deliver through review, exact-SHA CI and human gates with Lupin, Eiffel, Maigret, and Vauban. V1 covers YouTrack, Linear, and private personal GitHub Projects bound to a private repository. Bounded grooming writes and audited non-atomic Epic closure claim no provider CAS or concurrency exclusion. Linear uses an append-only lifecycle projection with targeted native state synchronization and witness-bound project Documents; native AC checkbox replacement remains unavailable. DevHubTracker remains optional outside the V1 qualification matrix.
defaultPrompt: Frame this idea into ADRs and precise issues.
Recommend the next issue by value and dependencies.
Review and merge this issue through every gate.
